channel.title: PAGASA VISPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA VISPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 01:46 PM 18 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Antique(Culasi), #Aklan(Madalag, Libacao), #Capiz(Jamindan), #Iloilo(Calinog and Lambunao) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Tapaz) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
